verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of customizable fields or user-defined workflow statuses. The only status-related items describe Linear adding fixed 'Proposed' and 'Canceled' statuses for initiatives, which is a vendor-shipped change, not team customization. A community user reports there is no way to add custom fields to different issue types.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can customize fields and workflow statuses to match my team's process
